findings.citation: plan.md Task A: the input is never mutated
findings.scenario: Test 'the input is not mutated' passes a primitive string; strings are immutable in JS, so the assertion cannot fail regardless of implementation. Guarantee holds by language semantics; test is vacuous.
truncate(['ab','c'], 1) returns the array unchanged (ran via node -e); truncate(null, 1) throws an incidental TypeError. Not required by plan; advisory only.
